title: Argentine leader says oil firms working off Falklands face sanctions
summary: Argentine President Javier Milei reiterated his country's claim to the Falkland Islands, warning that oil companies operating in the British overseas territory will face sanctions. The statement reflects ongoing territorial tensions and Argentina's attempt to pressure the UK through economic measures.
content: Javier Milei reiterates his country's claim on the British overseas territory, saying the "winds of change" favour it.

zh.title: 阿根廷领导人表示在福克兰群岛附近开采石油的公司将面临制裁
zh.summary: 阿根廷总统哈维尔·米莱重申了该国对福克兰群岛的主权要求，警告在这个英国海外领土开采石油的公司将面临制裁。这一声明反映了持续的领土紧张局势以及阿根廷通过经济措施对英国施压的尝试。

title: Goldman just revised this credit-market forecast thanks to the AI sector
summary: Goldman Sachs raised its forecast for USD investment-grade bond issuance after AI-related supply maintained strong momentum through the summer months. The revision reflects robust corporate financing activity driven by the expanding AI sector.
content: AI-related supply has helped USD investment grade gross issuance to keep its active momentum all through summer, prompting Goldman to raise its forecast higher.

zh.title: 由于AI行业，高盛刚刚修订了这一信贷市场预测
zh.summary: 高盛在AI相关供应整个夏季保持强劲势头后，提高了美元投资级债券发行的预测。这一修订反映了由AI行业扩张推动的强劲企业融资活动。

title: Volkswagen board approves plan to cut another 50,000 jobs
summary: Volkswagen's board approved plans to cut 50,000 additional jobs, bringing total workforce reductions to 100,000 by 2030 across its brands including Audi, Porsche, and Skoda. The cuts reflect industry restructuring amid technological transitions and cost pressures.
content: The group - which includes Audi, Porsche, Skoda as well as the VW brand - plans to cut a total of 100,000 by 2030.

zh.title: 大众汽车董事会批准另外裁员5万人的计划
zh.summary: 大众汽车董事会批准了裁员5万人的计划，使其包括奥迪、保时捷和斯柯达等品牌在2030年前的总裁员人数达到10万人。这些裁员反映了技术转型和成本压力下的行业重组。

title: South Korea's AI rally is reshaping romance, reality shows and academic preferences
summary: South Korea's rapid AI adoption is reshaping cultural norms around dating, entertainment preferences, and educational choices among the population. The trend demonstrates how quickly AI integration is influencing social behaviors and consumer preferences.
content: South Korea rally is changing what Koreans watch, how Koreans date, and what Koreans study.

zh.title: 韩国的AI浪潮正在重塑浪漫关系、真人秀和学术偏好
zh.summary: 韩国的AI快速应用正在改变人们对约会、娱乐偏好和教育选择的文化规范。这一趋势表明AI整合对社会行为和消费偏好的影响速度有多快。

title: A 'shakeout' in early-stage AI may be coming as VC money gets pickier on valuations
summary: Venture capital investors are becoming more selective about AI company valuations as the early-stage sector faces potential consolidation. Market observers warn of excessive valuations and emphasize focusing on actual productivity gains rather than hype.
content: Investors should keep an eye out for excessive valuations and focus on productivity when it comes to investing in AI companies, market watchers say.

zh.title: 随着风投资金对估值变得更加谨慎，早期AI领域可能出现"洗牌"
zh.summary: 随着早期AI部门面临潜在的整合，风险投资者对AI公司的估值变得更加谨慎。市场观察人士警告估值过高，强调应关注实际生产力收益而非炒作。

title: Adobe just announced its next CEO. Here’s why its stock is dropping.
summary: Adobe announced company veteran Anil Chakravarthy as its next CEO, but the stock declined as analysts raised concerns about leadership departures and potential further turnover. The market reaction reflects uncertainty about the company's strategic direction.
content: Incoming CEO Anil Chakravarthy is a company veteran. But another longtime business head will be departing Adobe, potentially foreshadowing further turnover in leadership.

zh.title: Adobe刚刚宣布了新CEO。这就是为什么其股价下跌的原因。
zh.summary: Adobe宣布公司资深人士Anil Chakravarthy为新CEO，但由于分析师对领导层离职和潜在进一步人事变动的担忧，股价下跌。市场反应反映了人们对该公司战略方向的不确定性。

title: Lululemon bets on ‘away from body’ pants as customers sour on form-fitting leggings
summary: Lululemon is pivoting toward looser-fitting apparel as customers abandon fitted leggings, while the company faces pressure from disappointing financial guidance. The strategic shift reflects changing consumer preferences and competitive challenges in the yoga-wear market.
content: Adobe’s stock is falling as analysts question the yoga-wear maker’s fashion assortment and digest its disappointing outlook.

zh.title: 露露柠檬押注"离身体"裤，消费者对贴身裤的热情消退
zh.summary: 露露柠檬在顾客放弃贴身裤的背景下转向更宽松的服装，同时公司面临令人失望的财务指引压力。这一战略转变反映了消费者偏好的变化和瑜伽服饰市场的竞争挑战。
